summary: Build practical ESG disclosure skills with GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB-aligned exercises. Train your team today.
lede: Sustainability and ESG disclosure turns environmental, social, and governance information into structured reporting outputs. This course is for professionals who coordinate or review ESG information and need to assess material issues, collect and validate data, and map disclosures to GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB reporting logic. Exercises include defining KPIs, drafting disclosure notes, and organizing evidence for consistent reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to turn sustainability information into credible ESG disclosure, reporting, and governance outputs.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of corporate reporting, sustainability topics, or risk/compliance processes; no coding required. You should be comfortable reviewing spreadsheets and business reports, but you do not need prior technical experience with ESG software. A laptop is recommended for hands-on exercises using disclosure templates, KPI trackers, and materiality tools. Advanced concepts such as ISSB alignment and double materiality are taught at an operational level, with practical application focused on reporting decisions and disclosure planning.
